title: PyTorch Sheet
blurb: Thirty problems that build PyTorch fluency from tensors and autograd up to optimizers, data pipelines and the layers inside real models. Each one asks you to reproduce what a built-in does, from the raw weights, and match it exactly.
prereq: You should know Python and basic NumPy array work, and roughly what a layer and a loss function are; the NumPy plan covers the array skills.
next: Go deeper into architectures with Cracking Deep Learning, or follow attention into large language models in the Inference Engineering course.
